newsitem.title: UK: Coca-Cola Amatil sets $750 million EMTN programme.
newsitem.headline: Coca-Cola Amatil sets $750 million EMTN programme.

text.p: Coca-Cola Amatil Ltd has signed a $750 million Euro Mediium Term Note programme, arranger Morgan Stanley & Co International said in a statement on Friday.

Coca-Cola Amatil Limited, incorporated in Australia, is one of the largest bottlers of the trademarked products of the Coca-Cola Company in the world. The EMTN programme is intended to become an integral part of Coca-Cola Amatil Ltd's funding platform.
There is allowance made for issuance in all currencies, with specific arrangements for marks and yen.
The programme has been rated A2 by Moody's Investor Service Inc and AA- by Standard and Poor's Ratings Group.
The programme will be listed on the Luxembourg Stock Exchange.
